02 · Website Development

Web development in Puerto Rico, hand-written and fast by construction

Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Fast by construction, not by plugin.

Request a quote Call (939) 229-9233

01 · Overview

Our web development in Puerto Rico is done in hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, not page builders or a stack of plugins. Every line of code is there for a reason. That gives you a site that loads quickly, is easy to maintain and does not break every time a third-party extension pushes an update.

We budget for performance the same way we budget for design: every kilobyte has to earn its place. Images are sized and lazy-loaded, fonts are subset and JavaScript is kept to what the page actually needs. The result works well on a mid-tier phone over mobile data, whether your customer is in Old San Juan, on the road in Mayagüez or anywhere else on the island.

We handle the full build: semantic, accessible markup, component-based styles, testing on real browsers and devices, and deployment with domain, DNS and SSL sorted. If the project includes a CMS, your team gets purpose-made blocks that cannot be arranged into something broken. We work with companies in San Juan, Carolina and across Puerto Rico, and remotely with clients on the US mainland, in the Caribbean and in Europe.

Semantic markup, a component-driven stylesheet and just enough JavaScript to do the job. We budget for performance the same way we budget for design: every kilobyte has to earn its place. The result loads quickly on a mid-tier phone over mobile data, which is where most of your traffic actually lives.

What's included

  • Semantic, accessible HTML5
  • Component-based CSS with design tokens
  • Vanilla JavaScript — no framework tax
  • Cross-browser and device QA
  • Deployment, DNS and SSL handled

02 Why it matters

What a San Juan web developer who writes the code gives you

01

Speed from the foundation up

A site without unnecessary plugins or heavy frameworks ships less and responds sooner. We hold every decision against a page-weight budget, so speed never depends on a last-minute optimisation pass.

02

Accessible by default

Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, readable contrast and alt text are part of the build, not a checklist at the end. An accessible site serves more people, and search engines understand it better too.

03

Less upkeep, fewer surprises

With no chain of plugins to update, there are fewer parts that can fail or open security holes. The code is organised by component, so any competent developer can read it and build on it later.

04

You own all of it

The code, domain and content are in your name. There are no licences tied to our agency and no platform you cannot leave. If you want to take the site in-house tomorrow, you can.

03 How we work

How we build your website

  1. 01

    Scope and technical plan

    We start from an approved design or your current site. We define pages, features, integrations and whether a CMS is needed, and set a performance budget. It all goes into a written brief with a fixed price.

  2. 02

    Component-based build

    We write semantic HTML, component-based CSS with design tokens and vanilla JavaScript only where it adds something. Each component is built once and reused, which keeps the site consistent and light.

  3. 03

    Testing on real devices

    We check the site across browsers, phones and tablets, measure Core Web Vitals and test accessibility with a keyboard and a screen reader. Anything that does not pass gets fixed before launch.

  4. 04

    Deployment and monitoring

    We set up hosting, domain, DNS and SSL and put the site live. For the first thirty days we monitor it and fix whatever comes up at no extra cost. After that you run it in-house or move to a care plan.

04 Who it's for

Who this web development service is for

  • Businesses with a slow site that loses visitors on mobile
  • Companies tired of updating plugins and fixing what they break
  • Teams with a finished design that needs to be built properly
  • Organisations that need an accessible, well-structured site for search
  • Businesses that want to own their code and their platform
